chapter: Childhood, family and the sounds of New Orleans
title: Father drawn into the Red-Light District by Ruby
summary: His father delivered liquor to the Basin Street joints, played piano a little, and was enticed by a prostitute named Ruby to leave home.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Uh-huh. What kind of fast life was that?

Well, there was the Red-Light District. And his route was bringing wine and beers and stimulants in the Red-Light District, which was infested with all kinds of strange people, fast women, pickpockets, shoplifters, and what you call "night people," who were indulging in everything that is illegal.

There was a special section in New Orleans that was called the Tenderloin, over at Basin Street... You hear "The Basin Street Blues," says, "Why don't you come along with me." And over there you went... You went into there because there was no curfew. I keep repeating that there was no curfew in New Orleans. And the city decided to put all these non-conforming people over in that section, and do what you want, 24 hours around the clock, but just stay over in there amongst your bunch.

My father used to deliver this wine, and heavy liquors, whiskey and beers, other stimulants, over to these joints. And all the joints, most of them had a piano. And he could play a little piano. And he met this woman, this fast woman there named Ruby. She had seen his mule, him and this mule. And he played these Blues on this piano, and he was pretty nice to look at -- and she inveigled him why he wanted to be foolin' around with that mule and that old truck when he could be over there. And the usual procedure was the woman
taking of a man, because fast women need some kind of protection. Because you could get kicked around if you didn't have a man to protect you.
Well, who played the piano? This lady?
My father played a little piano. But she was a fast and sportin' woman. She was a hooker.

And she inveigled him and kept enticing him with the easy life, and "Come on over," and you know... And he got involved with her, and next thing he starts shacking up with her and he stopped coming home, see. And he went into that life.
